capabilities: Edit common EXIF fields such as Description, Artist, Copyright, Date Taken, Software, Lens Model, and User Comment
Display GPS data on a map view
Edit raw EXIF data through an advanced JSON editor
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view or change the EXIF metadata embedded in photo files in a vault.
summary: EXIF editor that lets you edit photo metadata fields, view GPS data on a map, and modify raw EXIF JSON in image files.
